title: %pv - present value of an annuity
purpose: Discount a stream of equal payments to today: PMT x (1 - (1+r)^-n) / r.
notes: Receiving 1000 per period at 0.5% per period for 120 periods is worth about 90073.45 today.
First argument is the periodic payment; use %discount for a single future amount.
A zero rate falls back to payment x periods.
